## Voice Drafter — linkedin-skills ported into n8n
Called by other workflows (and by the Brain as a tool).
**Input:** task_type (comment | post | connection_note | post_accept_message | followup), context (JSON/text), max_chars
**Flow:** build prompt from the skill's voice rules → Groq drafts 3 variants → **deterministic Humanizer Lint** (JS, no LLM) → if nothing passes, one self-correction retry with the exact flags.
**Why it matters for interviews:** LLM output is never trusted blindly — a rule engine checks it.
